title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is a linear regression where the total cost is predicted based on the amount of vegetables and the type of meat. The intercept, $$\theta_0$$, represents the baseline cost when no vegetables are bought and the meat type is not specified.

title: Interpreting $$\theta_0$$
text: $$\Theta_0$$ is the intercept of the model. It represents the expected total cost when the amount of vegetables is zero and the meat type is not specified.

title: Analyzing the Data
text: Look at the data provided. When no vegetables are bought $$(veg=0)$$, the total cost varies depending on the type of meat. This suggests that $$\theta_0$$ is influenced by the baseline cost of meat.

title: Determining the Sign of $$\theta_0$$
text: Based on the data, when $$veg=0$$, the total cost is $$9$$ for chicken, $$13$$ for beef, and $$19$$ for fish. What does this suggest about the baseline cost represented by $$\theta_0$$?
